scope.hash_provenance: Exact full-file hashes supplied by implementing parent. Reviewer independently read corresponding source blocks; full-file hashes were not independently recomputed.

outcome.reader_static_review: accepted within stated filesystem and same-UID limits
outcome.new_fixtures: R1 has one Medium test defect; fixed source requires R2 acceptance

findings.evidence: The directory case calls read_private_token(self.root) and expects ValueError. Its immediate parent is /tmp. Reader lines 199-202 require immediate parent uid==current UID and mode exactly0700, so PermissionError occurs before a directory token descriptor is opened.
findings.impact: R1 directory-token coverage is ineffective and causes one test error. This is a fixture defect, not a reader bypass.
findings.recommendation: Create a mode0700 child such as self.root/'owned-directory' and pass it to the reader; its immediate parent then is the valid private self.root.

reader_evidence.evidence: Reader lines195-247 do not call S.snapshot, digest or hashlib, and return only the decoded string. Positive fixtures forbid S.snapshot, P.digest and P.hashlib.sha256.
S.open_parent lines46-61 walks from / using O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and dir_fd for every ancestor. It pins directories without following links.

reader_evidence.property: Immediate parent privacy before token open
reader_evidence.evidence: Reader lines199-202 require S_ISDIR, current UID and S_IMODE exactly0700 before os.open of credential.
Lines207-224 validate sameFD before and after: single-link ordinary file, current UID, exact0400 or0600.
Initial st_size>512 rejected before read; loop collects short reads with maximum513 bytes; len must equal initial size and <=512. ASCII.decode.strip then requires1..256 printable chars33..126.
Lines225-235 compare before/afterFD and linked name across dev/ino/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns/uid/nlink/fullmode; parentFD dev/ino/uid/fullmode also stable.
Nested finally blocks close both FDs before decode. Reader performs no write/chmod/chown/rename/unlink. Positive0400 and0600 fixtures compare mode/inode/bytes and identity metadata before/after.

tests.interpretation: Owned offline fixtures are regression evidence only; they do not qualify production HTTP/SSH/service inventory or cutover.

limits: S.open_parent rejects symlink traversal but does not establish every ancestor's trusted owner/mode or revalidate the complete current pathname after ancestor rename.
FD pinning, stat comparisons and the post-read linked-name check are consistency checks, not an atomic snapshot against arbitrary concurrent writers.
Private ownership is not a security boundary against code under the same UID or higher privilege. Timestamp checks are not a cryptographic content guarantee against such actors.
Parent timestamps are not compared; an exposure-and-restore of parent permissions between checkpoints is outside the guaranteed boundary.
No actual installed token or live HTTP/SSH/service operation was accessed by reviewer.
